name: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../tui run build && npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm --prefix ../protocol run build && npm --prefix ../client run build && npm run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig ./dist/bun/cli.js ../ai/src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile dist/pi && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/assets && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/core/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/ && shx mkdir -p dist/shell && shx cp src/shell/tree-sitter-bash.wasm dist/shell/ && shx mkdir -p dist/tools/code-mode && shx cp src/tools/code-mode/CUSTOM-TOOLS.md dist/tools/code-mode/ && npm run copy-tool-binaries && npm run copy-voice-assets
scripts.copy-tool-binaries: shx mkdir -p dist/tools/apply-patch dist/tools/exec dist/tools/view-image dist/tools/web-run dist/tools/imagegen && shx cp -r src/tools/apply-patch/bin dist/tools/apply-patch/ && shx cp -r src/tools/exec/bin dist/tools/exec/ && shx cp -r src/tools/view-image/bin dist/tools/view-image/ && shx cp -r src/tools/web-run/bin dist/tools/web-run/ && shx cp -r src/tools/imagegen/bin dist/tools/imagegen/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/assets && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && shx cp -r docs dist/ && shx cp -r examples dist/ && shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/ && node scripts/copy-codex-runtime-assets.mjs dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run shrinkwrap

author: Mario Zechner
